title: Researchers: South Korea’s Birth Rate Increase Last Year Unclear
titleZh: 研究者：韩国去年出生率上升情况尚不明确
credits: Hyung-Jin Kim reported on this story for the Associated Press. John Russell adapted it for VOA Learning English.

sentences.en: In 2024, the number of babies born in South Korea increased for the first time in nine years.
sentences.zh: 2024年，韩国的出生人口数量九年来首次增加。

sentences.en: The change is welcome news for a country that is dealing with serious population problems.
sentences.zh: 对于正面临严重人口问题的韩国来说，这一变化是个好消息。

sentences.en: South Korea’s statistics agency said recently that 238,300 babies were born last year, an increase of 8,300 from a year earlier.
sentences.zh: 韩国统计厅近日表示，去年韩国出生人口为23.83万人，比前一年增加了8300人。

sentences.en: The agency said the country’s fertility rate — the average number of babies born to each woman in her reproductive years — was 0.75 in 2024, up from 0.72 in 2023.
sentences.zh: 该机构称，韩国2024年的生育率——即育龄妇女平均生育子女数——为0.75，高于2023年的0.72。

sentences.en: The data represents the first time that the yearly number of births has increased since 2015.
sentences.zh: 数据显示，这是自2015年以来韩国年度出生人口数量首次增加。

sentences.en: Choi Yoon Kyung is an expert with the Korea Institute of Child Care and Education.
sentences.zh: 崔云京是韩国儿童保育与教育研究所的专家。

sentences.en: Choi told the Associated Press that researchers must wait for more data over the next few years to see if increased births were driven by “structural changes.”
sentences.zh: 崔云京告诉美联社，研究人员还需等待未来几年的更多数据，才能判断出生人口的增加是否由'结构性变化'所驱动。

sentences.en: Park Hyun Jung is with the government agency Statistics Korea.
sentences.zh: 朴贤静是韩国政府机构韩国统计厅的工作人员。

sentences.en: Park said the agency believes the rise is partly due to an increase in marriages following postponements of such plans during the COVID-19 pandemic.
sentences.zh: 朴贤静表示，该机构认为，生育率上升部分归因于新冠疫情疫情期间推迟婚事后，婚姻数量有所增加。

sentences.en: Park said another reason for the increase is that a growing number of people entered their early 30s.
sentences.zh: 朴贤静表示，出生人口增加的另一个原因是，越来越多的人进入30岁初期。

sentences.en: She also noted a government study that shows a small increase in the number of young people hoping to have children after marriage.
sentences.zh: 她还提到一项政府研究，该研究表明，婚后希望生育子女的年轻人数量略有增加。

sentences.en: Official data show South Korea’s fertility rate has been the lowest in the developed world in recent years.
sentences.zh: 官方数据显示，近年来韩国的生育率是发达国家中最低的。

sentences.en: In 2022, South Korea was the only country with a fertility rate below one, among members of the Paris-based Organization for Economic Cooperation and Development.
sentences.zh: 2022年，在总部位于巴黎的经济合作与发展组织成员国中，韩国是唯一生育率低于1的国家。

sentences.en: The low fertility rate could threaten South Korea’s economic health.
sentences.zh: 低生育率可能危及韩国的经济健康。

sentences.en: The country, Asia’s fourth largest economy, could face labor shortages and greater spending on public assistance programs.
sentences.zh: 作为亚洲第四大经济体，该国可能面临劳动力短缺以及公共援助项目支出的增加。

sentences.en: South Korea’s central and local governments have been increasingly offering several support programs to those who give birth to children.
sentences.zh: 韩国的中央政府和地方政府日益向生育子女的家庭提供多种支持项目。

sentences.en: But experts say that it will be difficult to solve the country’s population problems.
sentences.zh: 但专家表示，解决该国的人口问题将十分困难。

sentences.en: Many young people say they do not want to have babies.
sentences.zh: 许多年轻人表示他们不想生育子女。

sentences.en: Their reasons include costly housing, low levels of upward social movement, the high costs of raising and educating children, and a culture that requires women to do more of the childcare.
sentences.zh: 他们的理由包括住房成本高、向上社会流动程度低、抚养和教育子女成本高，以及一种要求女性承担更多育儿责任的文化。

sentences.en: Park said that the fertility rate will likely stay on an upward movement at least for another year.
sentences.zh: 朴贤静表示，生育率在未来至少一年内可能将继续保持上升趋势。

sentences.en: But observers say it remains to be seen whether the rate will go back down as post-pandemic marriages even out.
sentences.zh: 但是分析人士称，疫情后结婚人数趋于平稳，利率是否会回落到此前水平仍有待观察。

sentences.en: The country’s population structure will also change, with a drop in the number of people in their early 30s.
sentences.zh: 该国的人口结构也将发生变化，30岁出头的人口数量将会下降。

sentences.en: Some experts argue that the government should pay more attention to supporting young couples who want to have babies.
sentences.zh: 一些专家主张，政府应更加关注支持想要生育孩子的年轻夫妇。

sentences.en: “There are still people with solid wills to have a family and babies.
sentences.zh: “仍有一些意志坚定的人希望组建家庭、生育孩子。

sentences.en: When we help them realize their hopes, our fertility rate won’t suffer a steep, 45-degree drop,” Choi said.
sentences.zh: 当我们帮助他们实现愿望时，我们的生育率就不会出现45度那样的断崖式下跌”，崔说道。

sentences.en: I’m John Russell.
sentences.zh: 我是约翰·拉塞尔。

glossary.def: being or characterized by a very rapid increase or decline
glossary.zh: 陡峭的；险峻的；急剧上升或下降的
